name: Pip
subtitle: Pip, the money tracker with a coin mascot
description: Add this source to install Pip and get its updates.

apps.name: Pip
apps.subtitle: Track spending with Pip
apps.localizedDescription: Log what you spend in seconds, keep a daily streak, and see where your money goes. Pip cheers you on.
apps.versionDescription: Bills & subscriptions: see what your monthly bills cost a month and a year, with a calendar of what's due. Open it from the Bills card on Home or You › Every month. Pip also spots repeat Apple Pay charges (like Spotify) and asks if they're a monthly bill.
